title: RideLink Pickup Punctuality and No-Show Standards — Exhibit by Level
content:
This exhibit of the transportation broker contract fixes, for every Non-Emergency Medical Transportation level of service, the pickup window, the driver's wait, the late threshold, the alternative-ride maximum after a late pickup, the cancellation notice and the member no-show suspension terms. A 0 means the measure does not apply on that level.

| Level | Pickup window (minutes before or after the scheduled pickup) | Driver waits (minutes) | Late threshold (minutes past the end of the window) | Alternative-ride maximum after a late pickup (USD) | Cancellation notice (hours before pickup) | No-shows in a rolling 90 days that suspend | Suspensions apply | Suspension length (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RideLink Transit Pass | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | 15 | 10 | 30 | 50.00 | 2 | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | 15 | 10 | 30 | 50.00 | 2 | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 15 | 15 | 30 | 0.00 | 4 | 3 | Yes | 30 |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 30 | 15 | 45 | 0.00 | 4 | 0 | No | 0 |

## How the timing figures sit together

A pickup is on time inside the pickup window around the scheduled pickup time; the late threshold is counted from the end of that window.

*Hypothetical illustration, RideLink Ambulatory Sedan, scheduled pickup 10:00:*

| Clock time | Position |
|---|---|
| 09:45 to 10:15 | Inside the 15-minute pickup window |
| 10:45 | 30 minutes past the end of the window — exactly at the late threshold |
| 10:46 | More than 30 minutes past the end of the window |

*Hypothetical illustration, RideLink Stretcher Van, scheduled pickup 10:00:* the window runs 09:30 to 10:30 and the 45-minute late threshold is reached at 11:15.

## Points of reading

- The cancellation notice is the number of hours before the scheduled pickup by which a member cancellation is on time: 2 hours on RideLink Ambulatory Sedan and RideLink Door-to-Door Assist, 4 hours on RideLink Wheelchair Van and RideLink Stretcher Van.
- Member no-shows suspend trips only on RideLink Ambulatory Sedan, RideLink Door-to-Door Assist and RideLink Wheelchair Van, at 3 no-shows in a rolling 90 days, for 30 calendar days.
- Only RideLink Ambulatory Sedan and RideLink Door-to-Door Assist list an alternative-ride maximum above zero, 50.00 USD.
